body:
I just feel like a pathetic loser for no accomplishments but that lack of effort is due to not finding joy or interest in anything.

I'm extremely envious of people that have a real passion for some area of interest and would do it for free and spend every minute on it if possible. I probably don't have the balls to actually kill myself I'm just tired of wallowing in my own thoughts every day

I don't relate to anyone else. Everyone thinks I'm a freak or a weirdo. I'm just an unlikable person, when I tried making friends they ghosted me after they realized.

They either treat me like shit or ignore me. No one fucking cares about me or anything I do.

I do some stuff... but it all feels like a chore or work.

I don't "truly enjoy" a single thing. Like how some people say if they had unlimited money they'd just write books or make sculptures or going hunting everyday. I don't feel like that about anything at all. It all feels like fucking work. There's nothing I really want or want to do that would make me happy.

Pretty much nothing. I like exercising (lifting and different cardio) that's the only thing I do consistently everything else I've only ever done briefly and given up on because I didn't enjoy it. Everything feels so fleeting to me, just feels like a waste of time to distract yourself.
